blocks.text: It is simple to assume that there must be fire where there is smoke when public figures are accused. However, the presumption of innocence, the need for proof, and the distinction between association and complicity—principles that safeguard common people—do not vanish just because the accused are public officials. This is the core of what Atty. Tony La Viña, defending Senator Loren Legarda and her son, Batangas 1st District Representative Leandro Legarda Leviste, in the controversy involving the latter’s solar energy ventures.
